summary: No dossier sell trigger was tripped. Adobe took a Wells Fargo downgrade to Underweight with growth worries; this touches must-stay-true item 1 but is still a WATCH. Chips fell broadly on AI-funding and China competition worries (market-wide, METHOD 7). Super Micro stays an integrity question after a contractor's guilty plea. Trade Desk sits at its MOS price: value trap or event is still open. Searches could not confirm several moves, so they are marked unconfirmed.

items.headline: Wells Fargo cuts to Underweight, target $270 to $225; stock -4% (Oct 12)
items.why: Downgrade is fear, not business news, but the press quotes 'meaningful cracks' and new recurring revenue needing to nearly double. That touches must-stay-true 1 (ARR growth 8-10%); no sell trigger yet (needs <6% two years). Reason unconfirmed by my search. Price $242 is below MOS $269, above tranche 1 $225.

items.headline: At MOS $12.6 after a 68% fall; Q3 revenue floor of $650M in focus
items.why: Value-trap question (LESSONS): moat breach or solvable event? Check ad-spend share loss before buying (event check 6). Headlines only, unconfirmed.

items.headline: Product-line cuts and turnaround coverage; price $94.5 vs MOS $182
items.why: No dossier sell trigger hit; 'further CEO turnover' is still the one to watch. Product fix is an event only if solvable in 1-3 years (event checks 3-4).

items.why: Planned transition per the headline; my search could not confirm details. Read the 8-K for timing and successor (METHOD 4). Price $40.3 vs MOS $23.9, so not near buy price.

items.why: Company is not a defendant per reports, but past accounting and export problems make it an integrity question (METHOD 4). Price $41.9 is above MOS $32.4. Link between the plea and the price drop unconfirmed.
